columns.description: Country code of bill-to customer on a source document.

columns.name: L_UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure of inventory item or memo line on a source document line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the source document type. The name should be the same as the document type that is called in the source application

columns.name: OBLIGATION_REFERENCE
columns.description: User entered performance obligation reference or grouping attribute values used to identify the performance obligation as derived by enabling the Copy to Reference option in the Performance Obligation Identification rule.

columns.name: INITIAL_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Reference key that identifies the parent source document line for the current line.

columns.name: CONTRACT_UPDATE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Revenue contract update template identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the type of line sent from the source system. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE. Blank is equivalent to ORA_NEW_LINE.

columns.name: ADD_TO_CONTRACT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Specifies how a new line from the source system should be processed. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_ADD_TO_CONTRACT_ACTION. Blank is equivalent to ORA_ADD_TO_EXISTING_PO.

columns.name: TOP_PARENT_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Reference key that identifies the top most parent source document line for the current line.

columns.name: ADD_TO_CONTRACT_PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line of type ORA_ADD_TO_CONTRACT_NEW_LINE was processed.
